key_insight: Citation-linked case reports can yield clinically similar image pairs that improve medical image retrieval after model fine-tuning.
clinical_relevance: Retrieving images from clinically similar cases could support clinical reference, teaching and research, but diagnostic benefit was not established.
method: Follow citations between open-access PubMed Central case reports to identify potentially similar cases.
Use large language models to ask and answer hierarchical questions about modality, diagnosis and findings, then match images using captions.
Fine-tune BiomedCLIP on the resulting PMC-PaIR dataset.
evidence_signal: PMC-PaIR contains 86,144 image pairs from 56,013 case reports; experts judged pairs highly accurate, question-guided matching found twice as many correct pairs as direct matching, and fine-tuning improved retrieval across all tested categories.
watch_item: Case reports often feature rare or challenging presentations, so performance on routine clinical images requires further validation.
paper_title: A dataset of clinically similar image pairs from citation-linked case reports for medical image retrieval
